column1: # Oruhi lexicon. One word for each line. Columns: form, part of speech, gloss, tags, note.
# Tags: f frequent word (2 syllables), H holy word (contains o), S small (has i), L large (has a), D dark or deep (has u).
# A blank form is filled by `python3 src/cli.py gen`. A filled form never changes.

column5: the plain word for none, and the same form as the negative suffix
ends a yes or no question
the number zero and the Void; the holiest word
to pour out until nothing is left
holy: the state that is before and after all things
one who walks into the Great Empty to pray
the empty space between two fingers; the unit of counting
the desert that the people hold as holy ground
the circle; the sign of zero
the number one; the first break in the Void
the ring that has no end
the language, the voice of zero
